**Why qlub**

The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.

From Pay-at-Table and Digital Menus to Order-and-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.

We're a fast-scaling fintech backed by Mastercard, Mubadala, e& and Shorooq. $72M raised, live across multiple markets worldwide, and headcount doubled in the past year. We're building the teams that take us to the next stage.

**The role**

We need a Senior Data Engineer to own our data platform. Today it runs on GCP: BigQuery as the warehouse, dbt for modelling, Airflow for orchestration, and ClickHouse where we need low-latency analytics. jobs.description:
This is an AI-first job. At Linescripts everyone uses AI to do their job: research, writing, design, video, code and analysis. We want people who already work this way and get far more done with AI. In the interview, you will show us how you use AI on a real task.

**About Linescripts**

Linescripts Softwares Pvt. Ltd. implements Odoo ERP and builds AI into business workflows. We are building a young, AI-first team of developers to deliver ERP and AI implementations for our clients. Odoo is our main platform today, but the work is not limited to Odoo.

**What you will do**

* Build AI features (LLM APIs, agents, chatbots, automations) into the ERP and client workflows
* Customise and extend Odoo modules (Python, XML, PostgreSQL, JavaScript/OWL) with AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor and Copilot
* Help configure and implement Odoo for client projects alongside senior developers
* Learn any new stack fast with AI and ship quickly
* Write clean code, test, and document what you build

**Who we are looking for**

* BE, BTech, BCA, MCA, BSc CS or similar; 2024, 2025 or 2026 graduates welcome
* Daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar) is a must
* Good basics in Python and SQL; any Odoo, Django or Flask exposure is a big plus
* Curious, quick to pick up new things, and adapts easily
* A GitHub profile or project you built, ideally with AI, is a strong plus

**What you get**

* Structured training in Odoo and AI implementation

**Open Positions:** QA Intern

Job Description

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented **QA Intern** who is interested in learning software testing and quality assurance. The selected candidate will work with our development team to test web applications, identify bugs, verify features, and ensure product quality.

This internship provides practical experience working on real-world software projects.

Responsibilities

* Perform manual testing of web applications and software products.
* Identify, report, and track bugs and technical issues.
* Prepare and execute test cases and test scenarios.
* Perform functional, regression, and UI testing.
* Verify application features across different browsers and devices.
* Work closely with frontend and backend developers.
* Maintain proper testing documentation and reports.
* Participate in team meetings and project reviews.

Required Skills

* Basic understanding of software testing concepts.
* Knowledge of SDLC and STLC is an advantage.
* Understanding of manual testing and test case writing.
* Basic knowledge of web applications.
* Familiarity with Jira, Postman, or similar tools is a plus.
* Good communication and problem-solving skills.
* Willingness to learn and work in a team.
